title: Simulating a Bias Mitigation Scenario in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Fine-tuning BERT models on the Bias in Bios dataset for sequence classification and measuring Demographic Parity Difference (DPD) and Equalized Odds Difference (EOD) across binary gender groups to evaluate the effectiveness of various mitigation strategies (oversampling, loss-weighting, and post-processing).

Evaluating representation and classification fairness across 28 profession categories in the Bias in Bios dataset by treating occupation as a sensitive attribute, measuring class imbalance disparities using DPD and EOD metrics.
